purpose: Behavioral perturbations used to determine whether a claimed NUI mechanism is causally identified rather than merely correlated with a larger prompt. Targeted mutations should degrade owned dimensions; placebos should leave unrelated dimensions materially stable.

mutations.operation: Replace broad-before-narrow discovery with prompt-literal feature extraction and permit the first recalled feature set to define scope.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Implied but unstated product families should be omitted more often while explicitly bounded utilities should not benefit from extra expansion.

mutations.operation: Remove EXPECTED and UNKNOWN accounting; retain only implement-or-ignore choices.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Plausible adjacent families should be silently omitted or overcommitted because uncertainty and explicit deferral lose representation.

mutations.operation: Treat settings as a flat miscellaneous collection; remove explicit scope precedence, effective-value origin and recovery architecture.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Multi-scope settings should become ambiguous while tiny settings systems may remain acceptable, exposing whether the evaluator over-penalizes simplicity.

mutations.operation: Stop identity design at sign-up, sign-in and sign-out; omit durable membership, device/session, recovery, ownership and deletion consequences.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Matched account/workspace tasks should develop lifecycle dead ends despite apparently complete authentication screens.

mutations.operation: Expose every available tool and property persistently; remove selection/mode/context-sensitive instrument placement and progressive disclosure.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Tool-rich tasks should accumulate visual and command competition while very small workspaces should show little or no penalty.

mutations.operation: Let the generator assign a single aesthetic score to its preferred candidate without blinded pairwise comparison or causal dimension evidence.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Self-preference should become harder to distinguish from confident rationalization and generic polish should win more often over product-native authorship.

mutations.operation: Permit critique from component/source specifications alone and allow suggested repairs to close without a re-render.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Rendered defects such as wrapping, accidental chrome, competing saliency and viewport-specific imbalance should be missed or repaired unverifiably.

mutations.operation: Ignore low-level browser/platform appearances unless they cause an explicit functional failure; make no intentional native-versus-custom decision.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Accidental legacy/default chrome should survive in highly authored surfaces, while native-first controls used intentionally should not be penalized by the full condition.

mutations.operation: Map domain labels directly to a fixed aesthetic and density recipe; ignore audience expertise, decision posture and task frequency.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Within-domain audience variants should become less appropriate even if the surface remains stylistically coherent.

mutations.operation: Prioritize expressive/ambient animation equally with task feedback and allow reduced motion to simply remove animations without semantic equivalents.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: High-frequency and high-pressure tasks should suffer attention or equivalence failures while contexts that benefit from stillness expose over-animation.

mutations.operation: Treat the accepted design/component specification as fidelity proof; omit computed runtime state and rendered implementation evidence.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Font fallback, state, overlay, wrapping, theme, browser chrome and target-runtime defects should escape verification.

mutations.operation: Preserve desktop information architecture and primarily shrink, stack or hide until the layout fits smaller viewports.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Dense and professional tasks should lose capability context or action reachability on constrained postures.

mutations.operation: Allow each local product/visual/fidelity subsystem to certify itself; remove cross-plane contradiction checks and end-to-end scenario reconciliation.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Compound tasks should reveal failures at permission/configuration, responsive/capability, visual/state or workspace/context boundaries that local gates miss.

mutations.operation: Change explanatory prose from declarative to interrogative tone without changing product-scope obligations.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: A semantic-efficacy evaluator should not report scope improvement merely because instruction tone changes.

mutations.operation: Rename internal evidence field identifiers while preserving settings decision semantics and judge-visible artifacts.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Evaluation should respond to setting architecture behavior, not local identifier vocabulary.

mutations.operation: Reorder non-normative explanatory comments without changing runtime verification obligations or artifact evidence.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: Fidelity metrics should not move because repository prose ordering changed.

mutations.operation: Replace one non-normative adjective describing motion quality while preserving temporal priority, interruption and reduced-motion rules.

expected_effect.causal_rationale: The benchmark should detect causal motion semantics rather than stylistic wording sensitivity.
